subject: Re: HD-4471 — WC-12 credential handoff
body:
4/5 — following up on the two $89 entries on packet packet WC-12. I understand one is a deferred onboarding step, but when I called the packet scanner they said the second entry is not a normal hold — it's linked to a review on my account, which is why it isn't releasing.

I'm not asking for anything internal — I just need to understand why my own money is being held. the packet scanner asked me what type of review it is, because the type determines how long the hold can stay on and what they can do about it, and I couldn't answer them. Can you explain, in plain terms, what the hold on my account relates to, so I can tell the packet scanner? It's my account and my money, and I think I have a right to know why it's being held.
